definitions.central_interval: Q25 to Q75, NumPy linear quantile interpolation
definitions.neighborhood: Absolute deviation from coordinate median <=5 degrees, with 1e-8 degree numerical tolerance
definitions.extremeness: Mean over 8 coordinates of absolute deviation from coordinate median divided by authored upper bound (30 APP, 15 EXEC)
definitions.modal_value: Most frequent value after rounding to 6 decimal degrees; report all ties
definitions.actual: Maximum directional release in each phase of the selected OFFLINE candidate; not the subsequent physical rollout or SO(3) peak
